mapper.sql: SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN mkt05_share_cd = '1' THEN f_emp_kor_nm(mkt05_person_id) ELSE f_org_nm(mkt05_org_id, f_today()) END FROM mkt05_share WHERE mkt05_parent_id = mkt03_history_id ORDER BY mkt05_share_cd DESC LIMIT 1) ||(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '|| COUNT(*)-1 END) FROM mkt05_share WHERE mkt05_parent_id = mkt03_history_id

SELECT mkt04_history_id as history_id , MAX(fnd02_fund_nm) || CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 ' || (COUNT(*) - 1) END as fund_info FROM mkt04_relate_fund INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info ON ( fnd02_fund_code_id = mkt04_fund_id AND fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info WHERE fnd02_fund_code_id = mkt04_fund_id AND fnd02_work_date <= f_today() )) WHERE mkt04_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY mkt04_history_id
mapper.select: SELECT mkt03_history_id AS history_id , mkt03_person_id AS person_id , mkt03_reg_date AS reg_date , mkt03_target_company_id AS target_company_id , mkt01_target_company_nm AS target_company_name , mkt03_activity_date AS activity_date , mkt03_activity_title AS activity_title , mkt03_activity_content AS activity_content , f_get_empTrans(mkt03_person_id, mkt03_activity_date, 'person_org_info') AS person_org_name , ( SELECT COUNT(*)||'건' FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = mkt03_history_id ) AS file_count , ( SELECT MAX(fnd02_fund_nm) || CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 ' || (COUNT(*) - 1) END FROM mkt04_relate_fund INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info ON ( fnd02_fund_code_id = mkt04_fund_id AND fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info WHERE fnd02_fund_code_id = mkt04_fund_id AND fnd02_work_date <= mkt03_activity_date )) WHERE mkt04_history_id = mkt03_history_id ) AS fund_info , () AS share_info FROM mkt03_history INNER JOIN mkt01_target_company ON mkt01_target_company_id = mkt03_target_company_id WHERE mkt03_history_id = #{historyId} AND mkt03_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mkt03_history ( mkt03_history_id, mkt03_company_id, mkt03_person_id, mkt03_reg_date, mkt03_target_company_id , mkt03_activity_date, mkt03_activity_title, mkt03_activity_content ) VALUES ( #{r.historyId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, CURRENT_DATE, #{r.targetCompanyId} , #{r.activityDate}, #{r.activityTitle}, #{r.activityContent} )
mapper.select: SELECT mkt04_relate_fund_id AS relate_fund_id , mkt04_history_id AS history_id , mkt04_fund_id AS fund_id , fnd01_fund_cd AS fund_code , fnd02_fund_nm AS fund_name FROM mkt04_relate_fund INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code ON fnd01_fund_code_id = mkt04_fund_id INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info ON ( fnd02_fund_code_id = mkt04_fund_id AND fnd02_work_date = (SELECT MAX(fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info WHERE fnd02_fund_code_id = mkt04_fund_id AND fnd02_work_date <= f_today()) ) WHERE mkt04_history_id = #{historyId} AND mkt04_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mkt04_relate_fund ( mkt04_relate_fund_id, mkt04_history_id, mkt04_fund_id, mkt04_company_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{historyId}, #{fundId}, #{companyId} )
